This '''Yinchorri shuttle''' was used by the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was piloted by a [[Unidentified Yinchorri pilot|Yinchorri pilot]], who flew the craft to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to pick up [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] for a meeting with the Yinchorri [[Council of Elders (Yinchorri)|Council of Elders]]. The craft was shot down by a [[Unidentified Alderaanian stormtrooper|TIE pilot]] attempting to assassinate Organa, and the entire Yinchorri crew was killed in the crash.

The shuttle was a small streamlined craft with a single [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] situated on the top of the ship. Two engines were situated on opposite sides of the shuttle. The blaster cannon turret was accessible by a small ladder that sat next to the pilot's chair. Organa was strapped into the turret during the crash, which saved her when the shuttle crashed in the Yinchorri desert.
